description: This file implements the AttachSamples class, which manages attaching media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline, including creating buffers, updating media caps, and notifying the system when media data is needed.

classes.name: AttachSamples
classes.description: A class responsible for attaching media samples (audio and video) to the media pipeline, managing buffers, and signaling media data requirements.

methods.name: AttachSamples
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with media segments, creating buffers and extracting media data.

methods.name: ~AttachSamples
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the AttachSamples object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the process of attaching audio and video data to the media pipeline and notifies the system of media data needs.
